bullets.text: AI-Powered Makeup Filter - **Google Meet** introduces a virtual makeup feature to enhance video calls.
iOS 26.1 Beta Released - **Apple** adds a new security feature for automatic updates in its latest beta.
OpenAI's Ambitious Goal - **OpenAI** aims to transform $13 billion into $1 trillion in five years.
Coinbase Invests in CoinDCX - **Coinbase** boosts investment in India's CoinDCX, raising its valuation to $2.45 billion.
Samsung's Moohan Headset Teased - **Samsung** prepares to unveil its mixed reality headset at an upcoming event.
Stellantis' $13B Investment - **Stellantis** focuses on U.S. manufacturing, with limited emphasis on electric vehicles.
Netflix Enters Video Podcasts - **Netflix** partners with **Spotify** to stream video podcasts starting in 2026.
YouTube's New Video Player - **YouTube** rolls out a cleaner, more immersive video player across platforms.
AI in Firefox - **Mozilla** integrates **Perplexity's** AI answer engine into Firefox for enhanced search.
ChatGPT's New Features - **OpenAI** plans to allow adult users to engage in erotic conversations via ChatGPT.
